name: Equity Tracker
description: Track ISOs, NSOs, and RSUs with vesting and exercise/vest recording into Wealthfolio activities
author: Wealthfolio Community

permissions.purpose: List accounts so an exercise or vest can be recorded in the right one
Suggest ticker symbols from company name and look up assets before recording activities
Create TRANSFER_IN for RSU vests and BUY for option exercises
Read and update asset profiles so quote currency is set before recording activities
Update private company share price from valuations, read the current private-company price and put it back after an exercise
